subject: Removal request: assistant artifacts, execution logs, and prompt outputs (FinSight)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsight.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@finsight.io
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: Request: remove assistant artifacts, prompts, outputs, and execution logs

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the onboarding help last quarter. FinSight's legal team has cleared the retention hold for two projects and we need Redwood's assistance to fully remove all assistant-related artifacts created while we were testing the integration. Specifically we'd like: 

- All prompt text and generated outputs tied to customer IDs FS-* (tests and PII redaction included)
- KV store / cache entries created between 2026-03-01 and 2026-08-31
- Per-request execution logs and tracing data for the same window

Can you confirm Redwood's process and schedule for these deletions and provide an evidence bundle when complete? Our compliance team prefers a CSV manifest plus a signed acknowledgment (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Data Privacy Lead
FinSight

Attachments: none

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsight.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: remove assistant artifacts, prompts, outputs, and execution logs

Hi Alice —

We can handle this. High level plan: 

1) Intake & scope confirmation (today): we will map FS-* identifiers and confirm exact object namespaces.
2) Ops execution (48 hours): run targeted KV / prompt-output sweep and log expunction.
3) Evidence delivery (within 72 hours): CSV manifest + sweep logs + signed acknowledgment via DocuSign.

Monica (CS lead) and Priyom (platform ops) are looped in to run the playbook. Monica — please confirm there are no outstanding legal holds on FinSight for the specified IDs and add any sub-environments we should hit (staging/preview).

Alice — I will reply with a firm schedule after we validate scope.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: intake_template.csv (referenced)

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 07:30:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Request: remove assistant artifacts, prompts, outputs, and execution logs

Markus / Priyom — forwarding FinSight's request. Quick notes from CS: 

- FinSight confirmed legal hold cleared this morning (email chain saved in case notes).
- Primary IDs: FS-1000 through FS-1023 and FS-TST-XX (test namespace).
- Environments: prod-us-east-1 and staging-us-west-2.

Ops checklist (suggested):
- Snapshot current KV key list for the namespaces (csv)
- Run prefix deletion on KV cache and ensure KV cache TTLs are bypassed for immediate deletion
- Purge prompt-output artifacts from the object store and remove corresponding indices in the prompt catalog
- Delete per-request execution logs older than retention window and create sweep_log_{date}.txt

Priyom — can you confirm tools/permissions? If we need infra to schedule a maintenance window, let me know. Alice wants evidence and a DocuSign ack.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cs_scope_snapshot.csv

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ops-audit@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Request: remove assistant artifacts, prompts, outputs, and execution logs

Folks —

We executed the ops playbook against the listed namespaces in the requested environments. Summary of actions (completed):

- Identified 87 matching prompt-output object keys and removed from prompt-catalog index.
- Deleted 1,142 KV keys across prod-us-east-1 and 320 keys in staging-us-west-2.
- Purged per-request execution logs for the specified ID ranges and date window.
- Generated deletion_manifest.csv with object ids, deletion timestamps (UTC), and operator id.
- Created sweep_log_20261108.txt with checksums and job run IDs.

Evidence bundle (attached): deletion_manifest.csv, sweep_log_20261108.txt, and a compressed evidence bundle (deletion_evidence_bundle.zip) containing trimmed logs and redaction proofs. We also prepared the DocuSign acknowledgment request for Alice to sign.

Notes / caveats:
- Where prompt outputs contained customer-provided PII we've double-checked redaction before removal; redacted artifacts are listed in the manifest with redaction tags.
- Live cache hits after the sweep are possible for a short window for long-lived sessions; we forced KV invalidation and confirmed TTL enforcement for existing workers.

Next steps: Markus/Monica — please approve the evidence bundle and I will send the DocuSign link to FinSight. Ops recorded job IDs: job-ops-20261108-7 and job-ops-20261108-9.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Platform Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deletion_manifest.csv, sweep_log_20261108.txt, deletion_evidence_bundle.zip

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsight.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: remove assistant artifacts, prompts, outputs, and execution logs

Alice —

Confirmation: we executed the deletion playbook and attached the evidence bundle per your request. Items included: 

- deletion_manifest.csv (CSV of objects removed, redaction flag, operator, UTC timestamp)
- sweep_log_20261108.txt (job runs and checksums)
- deletion_evidence_bundle.zip (trimmed logs and redaction proofs)
- DocuSign: deletion acknowledgment prepared, link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/lookup/abc123-deletion-ack

Please review and sign the acknowledgment at your earliest convenience; once signed we'll update the HubSpot ticket (FS-4821) and close the case. If you need a longer audit package or additional raw logs, we can schedule a secure transfer via SFTP.

Thank you for working through this with us.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
